answer: Market access requires tending a one-shot kiln, not a copied badge. The applicant locks 36 coins and must keep a uniquely serialled ember-bed glowing in a public haven kiln for 19 hours, dripping a seed-chosen nectar oil at two posted clock marks at least 7 hours apart. Two fire-wardens who have never co-signed hash the bed color, oil residue, and serial. The bond unlocks only if both hashes match the seed palette and the serial is unused. A reused bed or the same warden pair burns both stakes, so a clone farm pays for a fresh kiln slot on every fake name.
